messages:
Amanda R.: Quick sync — proposing a phased plan for segmentation + routing across regions. Goal: reduce noisy cross-tenant interference and enable per-tenant SLAs without huge infra churn.
Kevin L.: high level phases?
Amanda R.: Phase 0: soft tags + policy layer (no isolation). Phase 1: logical slices (routing rules + soft tenant affinity). Phase 2: physical isolation lanes (node pools, quota limits). Phase 3: full regional split option for enterprise customers.
Mika (eng-ml): +1. Need to quantify perf delta per phase. Also models with large KV caches might behave differently in Phase 1 vs 2.
Jon P.: dependency: KV cache sharding work and runtime eviction API. Without that we can't safely move hot tenants into slice nodes.
Amanda R.: noted. Add KV cache sharding as a hard dependency for Phase 2.
Sarah T.: launch criteria for Phase 1? My suggestion: < 2% overall latency regression, no increase in tail errors, and end-to-end canary run for 48h with customer traffic sample.
Kevin L.: agree. Also requirement to have rollback policy + automatic fallback to shared pool if quotas breached.
ops-bot: Deploy checklist updated: https://redwood.internal/checklists/segmentation-rolling.json (automated entry) :white_check_mark:
Mika (eng-ml): test plan items: synthetic workload (short/long contexts), cross-tenant noisy burst, model-variant fallback. We should define perf budgets per model family.
Jon P.: infra workstreams: 1) routing policy DSL, 2) tenant metadata service, 3) node-pool tagging + autoscaler guardrails, 4) KV cache sharding. Timeline depends on resource prioritization.
Amanda R.: prioritization: customers asking for isolation > lower-latency tenants > enterprise SLA buyers. Proposed weight: 40% enterprise, 30% latency-sensitive, 30% cost/ops. Thoughts?
Sarah T.: that's reasonable. Also include an opt-in pilot lane for 2 enterprise customers before Phase 2 greenlight.
Kevin L.: what are the gating metrics for pilot success?
Mika (eng-ml): pilot gates: 99th p50 token latency delta < 10%, error rate delta < 0.5%, cost delta documented and < 20% higher unless customer pays for dedicated lane. Also no model-quality regressions observed in 2k eval prompts.
Jon P.: risk register item: cross-region fallback complexity. If we do per-region isolation, routing may need to dynamically rehydrate KV caches across regions — potential warmup cost. Add a mitigation: cross-region sticky routing with fast failover and pre-warm cache on failover events.
Amanda R.: good call. Add to roadmap: 'region warmstart patterns' research in Q3.
Sarah T.: ops requirements: audit logs + KMS integration must be available for private deployments before Phase 3.
Amanda R.: agreed — escalate to security for timeline.
Kevin L.: action items: 1) Jon to draft infra dependency map (due EOD Fri). 2) Mika to produce perf delta matrix for representative models (due Tue). 3) Sarah to propose pilot success metric doc (due Wed). 4) Amanda to sync with sales on pilot customers and timeline (due Mon).
Jon P.: +1 I'll include rollback steps and the pre-warm strategy in infra map.
Mika (eng-ml): will include model families and KV sensitivity.
ops-bot: Reminder: weekly architecture sync tomorrow 10am PT — added agenda item 'segmentation migration playbook'.
Amanda R.: thanks all — will post an updated roadmap slice and a trimmed spec this afternoon. :thumbsup:
